title: Config migration cleanup: authorization surface, stale prose, missing CI and doc-drift guards
description:
Findings 3-12 of the final review, batched — none behaviour-changing on their own, several widening the authorized-shell surface.

3 and 4 (authorization surface, do these carefully): the review reported two defects that widen what counts as authorized shell on the structured path. Re-read RESULT-wsc.md (archived under .tick/logs/herd/48d/) for the exact reproductions and fix both, preserving the rule that nothing outside the config file authorizes shell.
5-8: one small fix each, per the review.
9: runner.ts:1252 still instructs the operator to "add exactly one command mapping per item under ## Acceptance Evidence in .tick/config.md" — the exact prose removed everywhere else. Fires on the legacy path only, but a migrated repo hitting a legacy edge gets instructions for a shape it no longer has.
10-11 doc drift nothing checks: internal/herd/config/docexamples_test.go hand-transcribes runners-config.mds 6 worked examples with a comment saying to re-copy them; nothing verifies the transcription. pi-runner.mds TOML block is validated by nothing (manually checked valid). Make both machine-checked.
12: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs public-repo, go, ui, worker, factory and sandbox but NOTHING runs node --test extensions/ticks-runner/*.test.ts. This epic put the fail-closed authorization logic and a hand-rolled TOML parser in that module and added ~400 lines of tests CI will never execute. Add a job (~15 lines, mirroring worker).
Also: scripts/pi-ticks-live-scenario.ts (the epics A4 evidence) still writes MARKDOWN config and calls resolveRunnerConfig. Good news for the legacy path; it also means the structured path has no live end-to-end scenario at all. Give it one.
notes: 2026-08-19 23:08 - Seam: you share this wave with fdo, which owns the routing resolution in extensions/ticks-runner (readRouting/roleFor and the review/closeout/scout guards). Stay out of that code path. Your surface is the authorization-surface fixes, runner.ts:1252's stale prose, the doc-drift guards, .github/workflows/ci.yml and scripts/. The wsc review report with the exact reproductions for findings 3-9 is archived at .tick/logs/herd/48d/wsc.RESULT.md — read it first.
acceptance_criteria: Findings 3-9 fixed; the doc-example transcription and pi-runner.md TOML block are machine-validated; CI runs the extension tests; a live scenario exercises the structured path end to end.
